name: Ticket Validation Automation · Round 1
domainSummary: An identity-only ACE Hardware project landmark whose public-safe concept may suggest validation, controlled intake, repeatability, and automation but must not claim an actual internal workflow or architecture.
evidenceBoundary: The project name is the only factual source. Keep every functional cue illustrative; do not invent systems, outcomes, integrations, metrics, or skill links.

researchSources.title: Career World production inventory
researchSources.use: Approved identity-only boundary for ACE and Column projects.

researchSources.title: Canonical art brief
researchSources.use: Accepted ticket-gate pavilion geometry and explicit factual prohibitions.

assets.name: Ticket Validation Automation · Canonical Amplification
assets.controlledVariable: refine and amplify the accepted baseline geometry while preserving its defining silhouette; emphasize controlled intake
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested at its most resolved supporting-landmark scale. This version emphasizes controlled intake.

assets.name: Ticket Validation Automation · Process Spine
assets.controlledVariable: recompose the landmark along a clear sequential service spine with repeated but unequal chambers; emphasize repeatable validation
assets.thesis: A visible spatial sequence makes the project's process legible without arrows or diagrams. This version emphasizes repeatable validation.

assets.name: Ticket Validation Automation · Exchange Bridge
assets.controlledVariable: divide the major functions into unequal connected masses joined by one inhabited structural bridge; emphasize exception routing
assets.thesis: A physical bridge tests whether handoff and exchange should dominate the identity. This version emphasizes exception routing.

assets.name: Ticket Validation Automation · Checkpoint Court
assets.controlledVariable: organize the building around a protected validation court with layered thresholds and one decisive exit; emphasize operator review
assets.thesis: A central court makes review, validation, or adjudication the primary metaphor. This version emphasizes operator review.

assets.name: Ticket Validation Automation · Terraced Escalation
assets.controlledVariable: step the landmark upward through three or four connected terraces toward one compact focus; emphasize automation readiness
assets.thesis: Terraced hierarchy expresses staged progress and increasing commitment. This version emphasizes automation readiness.

assets.name: Ticket Validation Automation · Modular Batch
assets.controlledVariable: build the landmark from repeatable unequal modules locked to one continuous service base; emphasize controlled intake
assets.thesis: Repeatable modules test batch, scale, and replaceability without detached pieces. This version emphasizes controlled intake.

assets.name: Ticket Validation Automation · Guarded Recovery
assets.controlledVariable: place a protected core inside redundant connected routes with one visibly joined recovery annex; emphasize repeatable validation
assets.thesis: Guardrails and recovery become architectural without implying an unverified implementation. This version emphasizes repeatable validation.

assets.name: Ticket Validation Automation · Asymmetric Landmark
assets.controlledVariable: concentrate height and mass off-center to create one singular project-scale skyline; emphasize exception routing
assets.thesis: A deliberately asymmetric silhouette tests recognition at map scale. This version emphasizes exception routing.

assets.name: Ticket Validation Automation · Compact Deployment
assets.controlledVariable: compress the domain into the smallest dense, coherent project building that retains the accepted identity; emphasize operator review
assets.thesis: Compression tests which visual cues are essential rather than merely decorative. This version emphasizes operator review.

assets.name: Ticket Validation Automation · Domain Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance the strongest baseline, process, validation, exchange, and recovery cues in one resolved composition; emphasize automation readiness
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests a mature all-around project identity without becoming a city capital. This version emphasizes automation readiness.
